text:
maya: Heads up — cutting a hotpatch at 16:00 PT. PR #5821 (kv-cache edge-case fix) is blocked on one more review before the merge window. Need a quick extra pair of eyes + test signoff, please. @kevin @sophia any chance you can take a look in the next 10–15m?

kevin: On it, will review now. ping me if CI flakes. :eyes:

sophia: Can do a quick pass. Is this safe to cherry-pick to `rc/2024-06`?

maya: Yes, it’s a small, well-scoped change — only touches cache invalidation on older seq lengths. CI is green atm but we want the second human approval before cutoff.

ashwin: Running a local repro. looks like a formatting nit and one edge-condition I can test. leaving a small comment on the PR.

kevin: quick note — I left one comment about a nil-check, but it’s minor. LGTM after that gets fixed.

deploy-bot: Auto CI: build passed for PR #5821 — 8/8 checks green. (workflow/run-ci)

maya: Thanks. @kevin @sophia once we have LGTM from either of you I’ll queue the merge. ETA 15m.

kevin: pushed a tiny fix, re-ran the tests:
```
git checkout hotfix && git pull && git cherry-pick abc123def && ./scripts/test/unit.sh --package=kv-cache
```
All green locally, re-requesting review.

sophia: Verified the change, tests look stable in my rerun. LGTM. :rocket:

maya: Sweet — merging now. Merge command: `./scripts/release/merge-hotpatch.sh 5821`

deploy-bot: Deploy started for hotpatch 5821 — staging -> production. ETA ~6m. (deploy-bot)

team-release: Thanks everyone — keeping an eye on metrics. Will rollback if p99 spikes. :thumbsup:

maya: Closing thread — merged & release queued. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
